feature: Bug fix P0 — smart-fallback billing reminders + negative offsets + 0 (no vencimento) + diagnostic errors in history
summary: Validated SMART FALLBACK (1 reminder per tick, closest-to-today offset) — fixes the prod P0 of multiple simultaneous reminders. Backend: 4/4 pytest iter57 + 3/3 regression iter56 = 7/7 pass. Frontend: BillingReminderPanel under SA → Financeiro Admin → Cobranca subtab — chips for -2 ('2d apos'), 0 ('no vencimento'), 5 ('5d antes') render with correct labels; 99 and -50 are toast-rejected with range message; PUT persists across reload. Settings restored to production-safe baseline (days_before_due_list=[10]).

coverage_areas: PUT /api/super-admin/billing-reminder-settings accepts [10,3,0,-1,-3] and persists sorted desc
Scheduler smart-fallback: days_list=[10,3,1] + due=today+1 → only offset=1 fires (no spam)
Scheduler smart-fallback: days_list=[10,3,1] + due=today+3 → only offset=3 fires (regression iter56)
Negative offsets: days_list=[10,-2] + due=today-2 → 1 entry with days_before_due=-2
Diagnostic errors: history.error returns readable strings (no_sa_connection / http XXX / timeout_10s / exception:...)
POST /api/super-admin/finance/transactions/{id}/resend-reminder creates 1 manual_resend history row using representante as {{nome}}

tests_executed: Add -2 → chip 'billing-reminder-day-chip--2' renders with text '2d apos' (rose color)
Add 0 → chip 'billing-reminder-day-chip-0' renders with text 'no vencimento' (amber)
Add 5 → chip 'billing-reminder-day-chip-5' renders with text '5d antes' (indigo)
Add 99 → chip absent + toast 'Informe um valor entre -30 (dias apos) e 60 (dias antes)'
Add -50 → chip absent + same range toast
Reload + revisit subtab → chips [10, 5, 0, -2] all present (persistence OK)
Cleanup: removed -2, 0, 5 → saved → final state {[10]} verified via GET API

critical_code_review_comments: scheduler._process_billing_reminders smart-fallback picks min(O) where O >= days_until_due — confirmed correct logic; spam regression test (iter57 test_02) is the canary.
BillingReminderPanel.addDay correctly clips to [-30..60] client-side and BillingReminderSettingsIn pydantic validator clips server-side (defense in depth). LGTM.
chipLabel returns 'no vencimento' for 0, 'Nd antes' for positive, 'Nd apos' for negative — matches spec.

_send_billing_reminder returns (sent_ok, error_detail) tuple with readable strings (no_sa_connection, http {status}, timeout_10s, exception:{type}). billing_reminder_history.error field populated correctly — verified empirically that SA env has no WA so all entries land as failed with error='no_sa_connection' (expected).

Idempotency: successfully sent (txn, offset) pairs are not re-fired across ticks (test_iteration_56 test_02 runs scheduler twice; chip count for offset=3 stays bounded). Failed entries ARE retried — intentional resilience documented in code comment.
seed_data_creation: Test companies (TEST_SmartFB_*, TEST_LateFB_*, TEST_Diag_*, TEST_MultiOffset_*, TEST_Resend_*) created and DELETEd via pytest teardown + direct Mongo cleanup of super_admin_transactions + billing_reminder_history.
production_settings_restored: GET /api/super-admin/billing-reminder-settings returns {enabled:true, days_before_due_list:[10], lancamento_gen_days:10, channel:'whatsapp'} — production-safe baseline confirmed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Smart-fallback billing reminder bug fix fully validated. UI chip labels in PT-BR ('no vencimento', 'Nd apos', 'Nd antes') match spec. Range -30..60 enforced both client + server. If future tests run iter56/57 pytest, settings will be left at [10] for offset=5d test fixture, then iter57 test_01 mutates them — main agent should reset to [10] after any pytest run if needed.
